COMPACT DESIGN
A compact design creates more space inside your build, giving a greater flexibility without sacrificing performance.
PREMIUM COMPONENTS
Complete Japanese Capacitor and Infineon MOSFETs  deliver dependable performance, enhanced durability, and long-term reliability.
ECO COOLING DESIGN
Linear fan grill design and 120mm & F.D.B Fan with ECO function.Provides superb airflow for better heat dissipation thus maintaining overall efficiency.
120mm F.D.B COPPER SHAFT FAN
Cooper Shaft around bearing which provides stability and durability during operation thus better heat dissipation and longer life span.
EMBOSSED CABLE DESIGN
Low-profile embossed cables offer greater flexibility with less bulk, making cable routing easier while creating a cleaner, more refined build.
SUPER CONNECTOR
The patented universal connector architecture allows CPU, PCI-E, and peripheral cables to be connected across available 9-pin sockets, giving builders greater freedom in installation and cable management.
CERTIFIED PERFORMANCE
Proven Beyond the Spec.
Independently tested for efficiency and acoustic performance.
ECO-CONSCIOUS MATERIALS
Better for Your Build. Better for the Environment.Made with lead-free materials and designed to meet RoHS and WEE requirements for a more responsible product.
